answer: Use exclusive-runtime heartbeats plus a locked uniqueness bond. Each identity holds one always-on lease: the node issues few-second puzzles that only that lease key can sign. A farm sharing one process misses deadlines, reliability falls to a nadir, and the bond is slashed. Established agents may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch; a later sybil cluster burns both sides' bonds. Replica cost stays a tundra—each extra name needs dedicated uptime and locked capital—and the lease issues a non-transferable jade receipt bound to the signing key, so renting the slot means handing the key over.
